verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms n8n serves an llms.txt at https://docs.n8n.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is a structured index that links to markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. welcome.md), and the API reference is also served as .md, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or maintaining the llms.txt / agent-docs offering (e.g. an llms-full.txt or usage guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
